# Ruby::AZ

> The Arizona Ruby Users Group. Join us in the Valley of the Sun for discussions, presentations, and networking around the Ruby programming language and its ecosystem.

Ruby::AZ is a community of Ruby developers based in Arizona. We meet to discuss Ruby, Rails, and related technologies, share knowledge, and build connections.

## Events

We host regular meetups. Our past and upcoming events cover a wide range of topics, from beginner tutorials to advanced deployment strategies.

All events are posted on this website and on our social media channels.

## Links & Socials

- **Website**: [rubyaz.org](https://rubyaz.org)
- **Meetup**: [Join us on Meetup](https://www.meetup.com/ruby-az/)
- **Mastodon**: [@Ruby_AZ](https://ruby.social/@Ruby_AZ)
- **Bluesky**: [@rubyza.bsky.social](https://bsky.app/profile/rubyza.bsky.social)
- **RSS Feed**: [Feed](/feed.xml)
